system.name: TCSinger 2
system.one_liner: A multi-task multilingual zero-shot singing voice synthesis model with style transfer and style control from audio or text prompts, built on a flow-based transformer.

content.variant_note: panel (a) draws the whole generator from scores, prompt mel and noise to a mel spectrogram; panels (b) and (c) open the BBC Encoder and one Cus-MOE transformer block, tied to (a) only by their titles
content.argues: Blurred boundary content encoding, a contrastive custom audio encoder and a flow-based custom transformer with Cus-MOE together synthesise singing with style taken from an audio or text prompt.
content.subject: TCSinger 2's architecture: overall style-transfer path, the BBC Encoder chain and the flow-based custom transformer block

elements.name: BBC Encoder
elements.role: Blurred Boundary Content Encoder: turns lyrics and notes into the content embedding and masks tokens at boundaries
elements.drawn_as: pink rounded box with a pink outline at the bottom left of (a)

elements.name: Custom Audio Encoder
elements.role: encodes the prompt mel into audio-prompt embeddings; the figure also routes Gaussian noise through it to noisy embeddings
elements.drawn_as: light-blue rounded box with a blue outline

elements.name: Flow-based Custom Transformer
elements.role: maps content, prompt and noisy embeddings to audio embeddings with flow matching
elements.drawn_as: wide yellow rounded box above the token rows

elements.name: Audio Decoder
elements.role: turns the output audio embeddings into the generated mel spectrogram

elements.name: Lyric Encoder, Note Encoder

elements.name: Duration Predictor & Length Regulator

elements.drawn_as: grey rounded box fed by both encoders

elements.name: Blurred Boundary Adaptor
elements.role: masks tokens at phoneme and note boundaries so transitions blur
elements.drawn_as: pink rounded box with an output row of five tokens, the middle one hatched

elements.name: Norm & AdaLN
elements.role: normalisation layers of the transformer block
elements.drawn_as: two peach boxes in the block, one above Self-Attention and one below

elements.name: Self-Attention

elements.name: Cus-MOE
elements.role: custom mixture-of-experts layer in the block; takes a Language input

we combine the flowmatching technique, which can generate stable and smooth paths, to achieve robust and fast inference

summary: TCSinger 2 is a multilingual zero-shot singing voice synthesis model with style transfer and style control through audio or text prompts. Figure 1 gives its architecture in three lettered panels. Panel (a) shows the whole path: music scores go through the Blurred Boundary Content (BBC) Encoder, a prompt mel and Gaussian noise go through the Custom Audio Encoder, and their content, audio and noisy embeddings enter a flow-based custom transformer whose output goes to an audio decoder that makes a mel spectrogram. Panels (b) and (c) open the BBC Encoder and one transformer block with Cus-MOE, AdaLN, self-attention and an ODE solver. Embeddings are small tall tokens whose fill (plain, hatched, dotted) is explained by a legend.
summary_zh: TCSinger 2 是支持风格迁移与控制的多语种零样本歌声合成模型。图一分 (a)(b)(c) 三个面板：(a) 为整体流程，(b)(c) 分别展开 BBC 编码器和带 Cus-MOE 的流式 Transformer 模块；各类嵌入用不同填充的小方块表示。
notes: Only model-anatomy applies; the figure has no pipeline stages or worked example beyond the sample prompt. The meaning of the dotted F0 path and of the Language input into Cus-MOE is not explained in the figure or in the quoted paragraphs; that dotted lines mean an optional prompt path is inferred from the paper's wording 'optional audio prompt embedding'. The Gaussian Noise arrow ends at the Custom Audio Encoder box in the drawing even though the text says noise is added to the encoder output.
